page_title: SAS 2-2 PIS | Sassuolo v Pisa 24/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Cristian Volpato puts a cross into the box and finds Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 2:2.
90+3' Henrik Meister (Pisa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Pisa.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nemanja Matic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
85' The total number of attempts is 16:10.
82' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isak Vural (Pisa) replacing Michel Aebischer.

81' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Henrik Meister (Pisa) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Arijanet Muric. 1:2.
79' Pisa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
74' Shots on target – 4:2.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Josh Doig (Sassuolo) for Fali Cande.
72' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Ismael Kone and he is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
72' The game has come to an end for Samuele Angori. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Malthe Hojholt (Pisa).
71' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Adrian Semper as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
70' Some great controlled play and passing from Sassuolo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
68' A wild pass somehow finds Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
67' Henrik Meister (Pisa) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.

64' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
62' Referee Davide Di Marco has finally had enough of Alberto Gilardino and brandishes a yellow card at him!

62' What a miss! Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
60' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) replaces Alieu Fadera.
60' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
57' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. M'Bala Nzola will be replaced by Henrik Meister (Pisa).
57' Substitution. Matteo Tramoni makes way for Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
57' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
54' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo.
52' Samuele Angori (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
49' A pass by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' Neat passing move from Pisa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is replaced by Raul Albiol.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Grosso decided to make a change. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) is replaced by Woyo Coulibaly.
45+3' Davide Di Marco has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A rebound sits up nicely for Fali Cande (Sassuolo) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The ratio of the ball possession is 51:49.
43' Some patient build-up play from Pisa as they look to unlock the defence.
42' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

40' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
39' The resulting set piece from Pisa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

38' Pisa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Davide Di Marco and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

35' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
35' Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Sassuolo force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

32' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
30' 54:46 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
27' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) was quite harsh and Davide Di Marco didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Samuele Angori (Pisa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
20' The Pisa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

17' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
16' The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
14' Davide Di Marco blows for a foul after Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Pisa.

6' 1 - 1 Goal! Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Adrian Semper is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Arijanet Muric to commit before slotting the penalty into the top right corner.
4' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
3' The Pisa players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Pisa players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Davide Di Marco interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
1' PENALTY APPEAL after Idrissa Toure (Pisa) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Pisa will take the kick-off.
Davide Di Marco will supervise the game today.
